newsitem.title: USA: Allied Waste names Van Weelden CEO.
newsitem.headline: Allied Waste names Van Weelden CEO.

text.p: Allied Waste Industries Inc said it will name Thomas Van Weelden, currently president and chief operating officer, to the post of chief executive officer at the annual meeting July 2.

Roger Ramsey, current chairman and CEO, will remain chairman, the company said. He will continue as an active member of the company's senior management team, devoting more time to acquisitions and other strategic growth initiatives, it said.
Van Weelden will continue to hold the title of president, the company said. The COO position will not be filled at this time.
